Package dev.opencollab.paletter.block

Class VoxelShapes

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.block.VoxelShapes
public final class VoxelShapes extends Object
The voxel shapes of a palette: the shapes Bedrock culls the faces of neighbouring blocks with, which a server sends every client before start game (VoxelShapesPacket, protocol 924 and later). Vanilla shapes are the ones BDS of the palette's version sends; custom ones are those the layers define (PaletteLayer.Builder#voxelShape) and what Bedrock derives from them for the custom blocks that name them as the culling_shape of their minecraft:geometry.

These are culling shapes, not collision or selection shapes (BlockBehaviour#COLLISION_SHAPE is a BlockShape); the Script API does not expose them.

Since:
1.0.0
